title: Forecasting Intrathecal Tracer Enhancement from Pre-Contrast Brain MRI: Direct Regression versus Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.22377v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intrathecal contrast-enhanced MRI tracks how a cerebrospinal-fluid tracer spreads through the brain, but requires repeated scans over 24--48\,h. Forecasting enhancement from a pre-contrast scan could one day help select patients for intrathecal drug treatment and plan their dose. We ask how much of the enhancement at a given time can be predicted from the pre-contrast scan and the elapsed time alone. Training on 104 patients, we compared direct image-to-image regression (I2I) with conditional flow matching (CFM) using the same 3D U-Net and protocol, and tested on 23 held-out patients and 51 external patients with normal pressure hydrocephalus. All models were measured against simply copying the pre-contrast scan. translated_title: 从对比前脑部MRI预测鞘内示踪剂增强：直接回归与流匹配的对比
translated_abstract: 鞘内对比增强MRI可以追踪脑脊液示踪剂在大脑中的扩散情况，但需要在24至48小时内进行多次重复扫描。若能从对比前扫描预测增强情况，未来或可帮助筛选适合鞘内药物治疗的患者并规划其剂量。我们探究了仅凭对比前扫描和经过的时间，能在多大程度上预测给定时刻的增强情况。研究在104名患者上训练，使用相同的3D U-Net和实验协议，比较了直接图像到图像回归（I2I）与条件流匹配（CFM）两种方法，并在23名留出患者和51名外部正常压力脑积水患者上进行了测试。所有模型均以简单复制对比前扫描作为基准进行评估。I2I在内部数据上消除了约60%的复制误差，在外部数据上消除了约25%，在两个测试集上均优于CFM（平均绝对误差分别为0.036对0.058和0.056对0.063），且仅需一次前向传播即可预测每个体积。
tldr: 该研究比较了直接图像到图像回归与条件流匹配两种方法，发现直接回归在从对比前脑部MRI预测鞘内示踪剂增强方面表现更优，可消除约60%的内部复制误差和25%的外部复制误差，且计算效率更高。
en_tdlr: Direct image-to-image regression outperforms conditional flow matching in forecasting intrathecal tracer enhancement from pre-contrast brain MRI, removing about 60% of copying error internally and 25% externally while requiring only a single forward pass.
